command: product = YAML.load_file(".github/workflows/product-ci.yml"); cloud = YAML.load_file(".github/workflows/alien-cloud.yml"); abort "cloud experiment is not disabled" unless cloud.fetch("jobs").fetch("cloud-runtime").fetch("if") == "${{ false }}"; abort "unexpected CI OS coverage" unless product.fetch("jobs").fetch("verify").fetch("strategy").fetch("matrix").fetch("os").sort == ["macos-15", "ubuntu-24.04"]; puts "Both workflows parse; cloud job disabled; product CI covers macOS and Linux."
